learning_outcomes.text: Design simple game rules, a goal and a win/lose condition
Control a player sprite with keyboard input
Use cloning or loops to spawn obstacles or collectibles
Detect collisions and respond to them
Keep score and lives using variables
Playtest a game and improve it based on feedback

integrative_case: Learners build a 'dodge the asteroids' game: a spaceship steered by arrow keys, asteroids spawned as clones, collision detection that costs a life, a score that rises over time, and a game-over screen; friends playtest and suggest one improvement.
